author: Rfprrr
quote: Game is gigantic, but after 100% it, playing for 80 hours, and after playing Symphony of the night, even though that game is much older, i couldnt stop feeling like it was better than Silksong in basically every way.

author: Rfprrr
quote:
I am 10 hours in, and its one of the worst games i have ever played. The visuals are insanely pretty and realistic, but thats about it for the pros.
Bad writing, bad characters, the NPCs still act like robots, but with some stupid AI dialogue. Filled with stupid quick time events, and a bunch of time wasting, driving to places, following NPCs, and watching cutscenes.
I want to play, not watch a movie!!!
The game has bugs, and a bunch of broken animations.
Its overall just another brain dead open World game, like a lot of others nowadays. Full of things to do, but no fun to be had doing any of those things..

author: Rfprrr
quote:
Its the greatest game of all time, but better. Its prettier, runs smooth, and the cutscene are beautiful.
It changes basically nothing from the original, aside from very minor things, like spoiler and timers in some areas, but that changes absolutely nothing on the overall experience.
If the original game has a 9.9 score, the better version deserves nothing less than a 10, its simples as that.
